title: Family city walk plan
summary: A simple stay idea for families who want a light walk toward central Ternopil or Hydropark Topilche.
body: This is a guest mini guide rather than a paid quest.
Ask reception about the safest current walking route, especially with children or luggage.
steps: Choose city center or Topilche direction

title: Transit guest checklist
summary: A practical checklist for guests using the bus station or railway station during a short stay.
body: This checklist helps guests reduce friction before arrival.
It keeps important details crawlable without inventing a booking engine.
highlights: Useful for bus and rail travelers
